candidates.original_title: Intestinal inflammation targets cancer-inducing activity of the microbiota
candidates.description: Deletion of the pks island has little or no effect on survival of AOM-treated mice mono-associated with E. coli NC101.
candidates.citation_sentence: As described in the Registered Report (Eaton et al., 2015), we attempted a replication of the experiments reported in Figure 4A–F, and Supplemental Figure 7 and 10 of Arthur et al. (2012).
candidates.notes: Survival effects were in the same direction as the original, but the replication used an endpoint that was nine weeks longer than the original study and the comparable-timeframe analysis was exploratory. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
